notes: User explicitly authorized two-dataset source teacher guidance. One SharedTwoPriorGainR17 network/loss/inference rule; separately trained dataset weights and source-matched experts, action and teachers.

Start exactly at R17. Optimize KL(softmax(F(clean)) || softmax(F(output))) + 0.2 normalized IQ MSE(output,clean) + 1.5 normalized MSE(output(clean),R17(clean)). Real-frequency correction combines real-gain minus R17 with R17 backprojected physical residual.

WiSig uses original differentiable teacher processing. LoRa forward uses exact scipy original W24 aperture; backward uses existing WideTracker surrogate gradient via exact-forward straight-through estimator. Real-checkpoint first step verifies exact R17 initialization and finite nonzero teacher-loss gradient. Explicitly disclose approximation.

Frozen teachers/experts, no U TX, source V, target IQ/truth/statistics or cross-dataset checkpoint. Teacher sample forwards 8000 LoRa / 48000 WiSig plus gradient and parent costs; clean R17 anchor adds forward computation.

Source V panels repeatedly exposed; earlier WiSig direct-teacher source result and historical screens were visible before this version was specified. Fixed low-urban/clean same physical packets, controls, thresholds and truth-last; no target tuning.
